import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(20, 16))

# 1. Top 10 dog breeds by count
ax1 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 1)
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax1.invert_yaxis()
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, breed_counts.values)):
    ax1.text(count + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog distribution by district
ax2 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 2)
district_counts = df['KreisLang'].value_counts().sort_index()
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(district_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(district_counts.values, labels=district_counts.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax2.set_title('Dog Distribution by District', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(8)

# 3. Dog age distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 3)
age_order = df['AlterVHundLang'].dropna().unique()
age_order = sorted(age_order, key=lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]) if '-' in x else 0)
age_counts = df['AlterVHundLang'].value_counts().reindex(age_order)
ax3.bar(range(len(age_counts)), age_counts.values, color='skyblue')
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(age_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Dog Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', pad=2)

# 4. Dog gender distribution
ax4 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 4)
gender_counts = df['SexHundLang'].value_counts()
bars = ax4.bar(gender_counts.index, gender_counts.values, color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
ax4.set_xlabel('Gender', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, gender_counts.values)):
    ax4.text(i, bar.get_height() + bar.get_height()*0.01, f'{count:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=10)

# 5. Owner age distribution
ax5 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 5)
owner_age_counts = df['AlterV10Lang'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax5.bar(range(len(owner_age_counts)), owner_age_counts.values, color='lightgreen')
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(owner_age_counts)))
ax5.set_xticklabels(owner_age_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax5.set_xlabel('Owner Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Dog Owner Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.tick_params(axis='x', which='major', pad=2)

# 6. Registration trend over years
ax6 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 6)
year_counts = df['StichtagDatJahr'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax6.plot(year_counts.index, year_counts.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, markersize=6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Number of Registrations', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Dog Registration Trend (2015-2025)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
for year, count in year_counts.items():
    ax6.text(year, count + year_counts.max()*0.02, f'{count:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=8)

# 7. Most common dog colors
ax7 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 7)
color_counts = df['HundefarbeText'].value_counts().head(8)
bars = ax7.barh(range(len(color_counts)), color_counts.values)
ax7.set_yticks(range(len(color_counts)))
ax7.set_yticklabels(color_counts.index, fontsize=9)
ax7.invert_yaxis()
ax7.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Top 8 Dog Colors', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, color_counts.values)):
    ax7.text(count + bar.get_width()*0.01, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, 
             f'{count:,}', va='center', fontsize=9)

# 8. Mixed vs pure breeds
ax8 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 8)
mixed_pure = df['Rassetyp1Lang'].value_counts()
explode = [0.1 if i == 0 else 0 for i in range(len(mixed_pure))]
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax8.pie(mixed_pure.values, labels=mixed_pure.index, 
                                   autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, explode=explode)
ax8.set_title('Mixed vs Pure Breed Dogs', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)

# 9. Dogs per owner (AnzHunde distribution)
ax9 = plt.subplot(3, 3, 9)
dogs_per_owner = df['AnzHunde'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax9.bar(dogs_per_owner.index.astype(str), dogs_per_owner.values, color='gold')
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs per Owner', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Number of Owners', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Dogs per Owner Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, (bar, count) in enumerate(zip(bars, dogs_per_owner.values)):
    ax9.text(i, bar.get_height() + bar.get_height()*0.01, f'{count:,}', 
             ha='center', fontsize=9)

# Adjust layout and add overall title
plt.suptitle('Zurich Dog Registration Analysis (2015-2025)', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
plt.close()
